_comment: Temporary local run, no SQL Server reachable. Loaded only under ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Local (the 'Local' launch profile). Does not change appsettings.json or appsettings.Development.json. Every module and connection string stays as shipped — only the DB provider and the credential-dependent cloud integrations (which cannot work without real app registrations anyway) are swapped for local equivalents this app already supports. The Modules/Features overrides below are an exception: this demo is GTAA/Aviation-scoped, so Design, Style Guide and SLC (unrelated verticals) are turned off, and Sentinel's device-ops Configuration tabs are hidden while Sentinel itself (and its Pulse Reporting tab) stays on.
